title: Vividly Charred Dutch Peanut Stew
description: A dense and charred Dutch dish featuring roasted peanuts, nuka-pickle, and shojin-friendly ingredients, served in a banana leaf vessel, perfect for curing hangovers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Char the peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Slice the onion and mince the garlic, then saute them in a large pot until softened.
Add the carrots and potato to the pot, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the roasted peanuts, nuka-pickle, and vegetable broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Prepare the banana leaves by cutting them to size and brushing with water.
Spoon the stew onto the banana leaves, serving immediately.
